scope: T0_BRC companion tooling for exact finite count-centered carry, valuation holonomy, reciprocal quotient shells, Mobius geometry inversion, logarithmic gauge transfer, prime-cutoff divisor/Mobius factorization, degree-one large-prime time increments, symbolic reciprocal-wavelet geometry, and hard-prime skeleton/thickness diagnostics

tools.input_contract: Positive integer finite scales and branch indices; exact integer/Fraction valuation state; signed Mobius-log data only through the formal observer/deconvolution surface.
tools.output_contract: Exact carry counts, count-centered rational coefficients, prime-valuation holonomy, symbolic gamma/log forms, exact Mobius-divisor and reciprocal-shell deconvolution identities, and hard-prime n-th-power skeleton/thickness coordinates.
tools.reuse_rule: Use when a selected problem has doubling-carry branch geometry and requires observer-safe count centering, reciprocal quotient-shell compilation, or valuation-holonomy preservation before logarithmic readout. Reuse the exact finite surface unchanged before deriving analytic asymptotics.

tools.input_contract: Positive integer endpoint n with the exact GammaAffine reciprocal carry geometry and signed Mobius observer coefficients.
tools.output_contract: Exact divisor-lifting inverse check, rational log-valuation coordinates, and the endpoint logarithmic gauge transfer from mu(d) log(d) K(n/d) to mu(d) K(n/d) log(n/d), formally equivalent to the direct prime-error readout.
tools.reuse_rule: Use after exact Mobius-divisor deconvolution when a common endpoint logarithm can be removed by the divisor-lifting inverse. Preserve the signed observer layer and verify formal prime-log equivalence before any norm estimate.

tools.input_contract: Positive integer state and positive integer prime cutoff y; exact Dirichlet-incidence coefficients only.
tools.output_contract: Unique smooth/rough prime-factor split; exact Z and Mobius recoalescence across the cutoff; exact formal small/rough von-Mangoldt log connections; finite rough-support degree certificate.
tools.reuse_rule: Use to separate a Mobius/divisor lifting into small-prime and rough-prime algebra before invoking analytic estimates. When y^2 covers the finite block, use the certified degree-one rough support rather than expanding nonexistent rough semiprime branches.

tools.input_contract: Positive integer time n, odd prime branch p when using residue identities, and positive integer large-prime cutoff y.
tools.output_contract: Exact half-residue carry, exact one-step divisibility increment, pointwise selected large-prime valuation state, rough-radical endpoint compiler, and degree-one rough certificate when y^2 exceeds the active linear-form range.
tools.reuse_rule: Use only after the prime-cutoff connection has reduced the unresolved observer to the complete pointwise large-prime layer. Preserve outer primes p<=n and use the increment compiler instead of a frozen p<=N surrogate.
